text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a challenge taken knowing the odds 
were stacked against us. In the end, 
victory at the Satsuki Sho remained out of 
reach...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, whew... What was with that 
fierce battle for position...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Part of it's because I'm small, but even 
if you were huge, this would still be 
rough..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So this is the Classic Triple Crown. This 
is the Satsuki Sho. Man, that really is 
something else.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Man, that was brutally 
exhausting...
choice_data_list:
Sounds like there were others who had a 
rough time too.

Looks like other girls had a tough time as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see. In a race this big, standin' out 
really does work against ya, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No matter where she went, she was marked. 
Even so, she never uttered a single 
complaint...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross took the initiative to 
approach Gold City, and...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Good work, City. That was tough on both of 
us, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Still, those eyes... look like they 
haven't given up. They're shining with a 
far fiercer glare than your hair."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Umamusume aren't defined by looks. 
I think so too...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And it's not about body size either. There 
are Umamusume with tons of guts locked 
inside, just like Tamamo-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, ain't that the truth. Same goes for 
me, but you're a lot tougher than you look 
too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Let's keep it up together from now on! 
Having a classmate like you gets my heart 
pounding with excitement!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nodding, the two stared at each other with 
burning eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though their appearances differed, their 
souls seemed to share the exact same 
color.
